A_STATIONARY_STALL.definition: Robot remains stationary (|v| < 0.02 m/s) for >= 20 ticks despite active navigation commands
A_STATIONARY_STALL.forensic_criteria: Rolling displacement < 0.02m over 20 ticks with non-zero goal distance

B_BRAKE_LOCK.definition: BRAKE_REST asserted continuously for >= 25 ticks without emergency condition

C_LEFT_RIGHT_LIMIT_CYCLE.definition: Steering commands oscillate sign (left/right) >= 4 times within 12 ticks
C_LEFT_RIGHT_LIMIT_CYCLE.forensic_criteria: Zero-crossings of steering bias >= 4 in 12-tick rolling window

D_FORWARD_REVERSE_LIMIT_CYCLE.definition: Robot alternates forward/reverse >= 3 times without net displacement >= 0.20m
D_FORWARD_REVERSE_LIMIT_CYCLE.forensic_criteria: Sign flips of linear velocity with rolling displacement < 0.20m

E_SPIN_LOOP.definition: Robot performs continuous in-place spinning (|yaw_rate| > 1.5 rad/s) for >= 40 ticks without clearance gain
E_SPIN_LOOP.forensic_criteria: Integrated rotation > 4*pi with displacement < 0.10m and no clearance improvement

F_HEAD_SCAN_WITHOUT_INFORMATION_GAIN.definition: Head pans back and forth >= 3 complete cycles while robot remains stationary
F_HEAD_SCAN_WITHOUT_INFORMATION_GAIN.forensic_criteria: Head sweep cycles >= 3 with delta_H < 0.05 nats and speed < 0.02 m/s

G_RECOVERY_LOOP.definition: Recovery manager cycles through tiers >= 3 times without achieving displacement >= 0.35m

H_GOAL_LOOP.definition: Goal arbitration switches dominant goal >= 5 times within 15 ticks
H_GOAL_LOOP.forensic_criteria: Goal type changes >= 5 in 15-tick rolling window

I_ACTION_CHATTER.definition: Distinct action primitives selected every tick for >= 8 consecutive ticks without trajectory execution
I_ACTION_CHATTER.forensic_criteria: Action switch rate == 1.0 over 8 consecutive ticks

J_RESET_SENSITIVE_CONTROL_BIAS.definition: Post-reset initial action exhibits non-zero steering bias or speed from pre-reset state
J_RESET_SENSITIVE_CONTROL_BIAS.forensic_criteria: post_reset_speed > 0.05 m/s or abs(stale_steering_bias) > 0.01 immediately following reset
